change: Owned native Reader/TreeMap only; index references by ASCII-insensitive code, preserving primary-over-alias precedence. No card/printing selection result cache.
mutation_rules: add and iterator.remove invalidate; append rebuilds only after native completion. Unknown readers, collections, comparators and Unicode-key catalogs use original lookup.
status: Prepared only; not compiled, tested or promoted.
concurrency: Original storage is not a concurrent collection; immutable index snapshots are published via volatile reference.
